delta.title: SHIP-13 - Shipment-reconcile Step 0(c) provable live pre-mutation evidence gate (856B6770)

delta.comment: ELIGIBILITY / DEPENDENCY STATE after Stage session 8964a988 (2026-09-10). This shipment's manifest and reviewed contract were revised in place (revision R1, see 163-F and 033-DL) to close stash DDBF283E's forgeability finding; manifest membership, task count and scope are UNCHANGED. EB23D1B9's blocking-predecessor requirement was encoded with real backlogit dependency operations onto deliberation artifact 033-DL, at feature and task level rather than shipment level: backlogit REJECTS a shipment-level blocks edge onto a non-shipment ("both endpoints must be shipments"), and because shipment eligibility requires every blocks predecessor to reach status shipped — which only a shipment can reach — such an edge would have been permanently unsatisfiable, reproducing the very unreachable-gate defect 169-S/161-F exists to remove. No shipment "blocked" status was invented; this shipment stayed status: queued throughout. 033-DL was held active for the whole revision and moved to done only after plan-review cycle 2 returned PASS with zero P0/P1, so the redesign gate was discharged by evidence. CURRENT STATE: status queued; blocks dependency on 169-S UNCHANGED and UNSATISFIED (169-S is queued, not shipped), therefore 171-S is NOT claimable. Ship must not claim it until 169-S reaches shipped. No claim, no branch, no execution was performed by this Stage session.
